title: Declared dependencies and runtime configuration
description: Inspect the actual manifests .github/workflows/test.yml, environment.yml, readthedocs.yml, requirements.txt. Separate declared packages/settings from imports, installed state, secrets, and runtime success. The test/configuration evidence is traced into implementation rrmpg/models/__init__.py.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in .github/workflows/test.yml, environment.yml, readthedocs.yml, requirements.txt.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for .github/workflows/test.yml, environment.yml, readthedocs.yml, requirements.txt
